$comment: Policy for scripts/orchestrate.mjs (docs/specs/agent-orchestration.md). Only free or local models: orchestrate.mjs refuses any model that isn't kilo/...:free, kilo/kilo-auto/free or ollama/..., whatever this list says. Interactive sessions keep their own models.

verify.$allow_missing: Steps whose tool may be absent on the maintainer's Mac; CI runs them (PSScriptAnalyzer: the Windows job).
verify.$full_when_paths: A diff touching none of these is verified with --quick (no web build; the build downloads fonts and fails offline).

$sensitive_paths: A diff touching any of these needs a person: what the checks enforce lives here (lint, test and type configs, lockfiles, scripts, agent rules), so a worker could otherwise pass by weakening it. orchestrate.mjs also blocks added suppressions (noqa, skip, xfail, eslint-disable, ts-ignore, type: ignore) and deleted test files.
